test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word **
solution:
The erroneous spelling is "**Abscent**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **correct spelling **and **meaning **of the word.

 
 
• **Absent**: 

 not present in a place, at an occasion, or as part of something.

 
 
• **Example**: *Aaron doesn't want to be **absent **__on the first day of his new job, so he set an alarm.*
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• ** **Let's look at the meaning of the other words.

 
 
• **​Absolute: **

 not qualified or diminished in any way; total.
 
 
• **Absorb: **
 take in and understand fully (information, ideas, or experience).
 
 
• **Abstract: **
 existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical or concrete existence.
 
 
 

 
• All the other words are **spelled correctly.**
